request.description: The file as the lender received it: the decrypted packet snapshot (application, borrower and co-party facts, score, match reasons, document list), documents shared with the lender (packet, evidence, fulfilled requests), document requests and events. Lender context: admins and credit officers act, viewers read. Only files already sent to the signed-in lender's organization are visible. The response adds `attributeLabels` (fact key → label in the request language) for the facts in the packet.
